client_rules: No direct eye contact with the camera; subject looks off-camera.
Shoot guide Oct 8: questions, not lines. Matt asks questions and never feeds lines. We keep what people actually say.
Rejected before (2026-10-08): interviewer-fed tagline used as a testimonial.
Every voice has a face; face first; no voiceover from someone we never see.
